Title: Insecure CORS Policy Reflecting Arbitrary Origins with Credentials
Description: Backend dynamically echoes any requested Origin header in Access-Control-Allow-Origin while enabling Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true on preflight requests.
Remediation Summary: Restrict CORS allowed origins strictly to https://knotnow.co and trusted administrative origins. Never reflect arbitrary origins with credentials.

Title: Plaintext JWT Access and Refresh Tokens Logged to Console and Telemetry
Description: Tokens are printed in plaintext to the browser console and telemetry breadcrumbs during initialization and token refreshes via TokensStorage logger.
Remediation Summary: Remove sensitive token strings from client logging and telemetry breadcrumbs. Log only token lifecycle events without the credential payload.

Title: Missing HTTP Security Headers (CSP Frame-Options Content-Type-Options)
Description: The frontend does not serve Content-Security-Policy X-Frame-Options or X-Content-Type-Options leaving the app vulnerable to clickjacking and unmitigated XSS.
Remediation Summary: Deploy standard HTTP security headers including Content-Security-Policy with frame-ancestors 'self' and X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff on Azure Front Door.

Title: Global Window Exposure of LocalStorageBridge Debug Utilities
Description: The LocalStorageBridge object is attached to window and includes a debug() method capable of dumping all localStorage keys and values.
Remediation Summary: Remove debug methods from production builds and avoid attaching unnecessary storage helpers to the global window object.

Title: Potential Broken Object Level Authorization (BOLA/IDOR) on Order Details and Updates
Description: Order endpoints accept object IDs in URL path and body without client-side proof of server-side ownership validation.
Remediation Summary: Enforce strict server-side resource ownership checks ensuring orders belong to the authenticated user ID before returning data or modifying slots.

Title: Potential Broken Object Level Authorization (BOLA/IDOR) on Customer Addresses
Description: Saved address details are queried by address_id query parameter. If ownership is not verified
Verification Status: customer locations and phone numbers could be exposed.
column9: Ensure SQL/NoSQL queries include WHERE address_id = :id AND user_id = :authenticated_user_id.

Title: Payment Verification Architecture Reliance on Client-Submitted Order ID
Description: Wallet recharge verification passes only order_id to backend. If backend does not query Razorpay server-to-server or verify HMAC signature
column9: Ensure backend verifies payment completion directly with Razorpay API (GET /v1/orders/{id}) and verifies HMAC-SHA256 signature before crediting wallet ledger.

Title: Storage of Sensitive Authentication Tokens in Browser localStorage
Description: Access and refresh tokens are stored in unencrypted HTML5 localStorage making them accessible to any script executing in the origin context.
Remediation Summary: Migrate session management to HttpOnly Secure SameSite=Lax cookies to isolate session tokens from JavaScript access.
